title: Tensor cohomology in the intrinsic coefficient presentation
statement: For a finite commutative ring A and a scheme T, let F be the canonical intrinsic realization of fixed-scalar pro-etale module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let K be any fixed-scalar derived object; let L,P be intrinsic complexes, eL:Q(L) ≅ D(F)(K), and f:P → L a quasi-isomorphism with P K-flat. For a fixed-scalar module sheaf N, an intrinsic module sheaf M and eM:F(N) ≅ M, for every integer i there exists an isomorphism H^i(derivedTensor(L,M[0],P,f)) ≅ F(H^i(K tensor^L N[0])). No boundedness, Tor bound or etale-origin hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YU, 08FZ; coefficient presentation via Modules on Sites, Tag 00YV

proof.text: Use the exact additive equivalence F from the coefficient presentation. Its inverse on complexes takes P to a complex P′ with F(P′) ≅ P. For any acyclic fixed-scalar complex V, F(V) is acyclic; the ordinary total tensor comparison identifies F(V tensor P′) with F(V) tensor P. The intrinsic K-flat hypothesis on P makes this acyclic. Exactness and faithfulness of F reflect acyclicity, so P′ is K-flat.

The quasi-isomorphism P → L and the given eL produce D(F)(Q(P′)) ≅ D(F)(K). Full faithfulness of the derived equivalence lifts this to Q(P′) ≅ K. The source-library K-flat single-tensor representative theorem computes K tensor^L N[0] using P′. Apply ordinary tensor comparison and the single-complex comparison, then the supplied eM to identify the other factor. This gives an isomorphism of derived objects before any cohomology is taken.
Apply derived homology in degree i and the exact-functor homology isomorphism. This proves the stated single-test comparison for arbitrary P, without choosing a resolution of K.

theorem intrinsic_resolution_tensor_homology_iso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A))))
    (L P : CochainComplex
      (Scheme.proEtaleRingModules T (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T A)) ℤ)
    (eL : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj L ≅
      (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization T A).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
    (f : P ⟶ L) (hf : QuasiIso f)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat P)
    (N : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))
    (M : Scheme.proEtaleRingModules T (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T A))
    (eM : (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization T A).obj N ≅ M) (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
        (Scheme.derivedTensor T A L
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj M) P f hf hP) ≅
        (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization T A).obj
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
            (((ProEtale.derivedTensor
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) T).obj K).obj
              ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N))))
